title: Personalized Treatment Outcome Prediction from Scarce Data via Dual-Channel Knowledge Distillation and Adaptive Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2510.26444v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personalized treatment outcome prediction based on trial data for small-sample and rare patient groups is a critical task in precision medicine. However, the high cost and scarcity of trial data limit the prediction performance. To address this issue, we propose a cross-fidelity knowledge distillation and adaptive fusion network (CFKD-AFN), which leverages abundant but low-fidelity simulation data to enhance the prediction on scarce but high-fidelity trial data. CFKD-AFN incorporates a dual-channel knowledge distillation module to extract complementary knowledge from the low-fidelity model, along with an attention-guided fusion module to adaptively integrate multi-source information. Experiments on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease show that CFKD-AFN reduces the mean squared error by 6.67% ~ 74.55% and the mean absolute percentage error by 1.43% ~ 51.54% compared to the evaluated competing methods and remains robust to vary

translated_title: 基于双通道知识蒸馏与自适应融合的稀缺数据个性化治疗结果预测
translated_abstract: 基于试验数据对小样本和罕见患者群体进行个性化治疗结果预测是精准医学中的一项关键任务。然而，试验数据的高成本和稀缺性限制了预测性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种跨保真度知识蒸馏与自适应融合网络（CFKD-AFN），该网络利用丰富但低保真度的仿真数据来增强对稀缺但高保真度试验数据的预测。CFKD-AFN 包含一个双通道知识蒸馏模块，用于从低保真度模型中提取互补知识，以及一个注意力引导的融合模块，用于自适应地整合多源信息。在慢性阻塞性肺疾病上的实验表明，与所评估的竞争方法相比，CFKD-AFN 将均方误差降低了 6.67% ~ 74.55%，平均绝对百分比误差降低了 1.43% ~ 51.54%，并且对变化保持稳健。
tldr: 提出跨保真度知识蒸馏与自适应融合网络（CFKD-AFN），利用丰富的低保真度仿真数据，通过双通道知识蒸馏和注意力引导融合，增强小样本罕见患者群体的个性化治疗结果预测，在慢性阻塞性肺疾病数据上显著降低预测误差。
en_tdlr: Proposes CFKD-AFN, a cross-fidelity knowledge distillation and adaptive fusion network that leverages abundant low-fidelity simulation data through dual-channel knowledge distillation and attention-guided fusion to improve personalized treatment outcome prediction for small-sample rare patient groups, substantially reducing prediction errors on COPD data.
